newsitem.title: USA: Ryder to sell unit to Allied Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Ryder to sell unit to Allied Holdings.

text.p: Ryder System Inc said it has agreed to sell its Ryder Automotive Carrier Services Inc and RC Management Corp to Allied Holdings Inc for about $114.5 million in cash and the assumption of liabilities.
The company said the sale is expected to close before the end of 1997 and it expects to report a gain on the deal.
Allied said in a separate statement that combined revenue with Ryder's automotive carrier divisions for 1996 would have been about $1 billion.
Allied Holdings is the parent of several subsidiaries in the automotive distribution business.
Ryder Automotive Carrier Services, a highway transporter of cars and trucks headquarted in Michigan, accounted for about $600 million of Ryder's $5.5 billion of revenue in 1996.
